page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-standardlssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. It features 88 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 44 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 704 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. For local storage, it includes six NVMe SSDs totaling 19,326 GB of capacity, offering substantial local storage space without relying on external network-attached volumes.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with the stress-ng multi-core CPU test and PassMark CPU score ranking in the top 25%. The Intel Xeon architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to strong performance in extended instructions and encryption workloads. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only cached small block transfers reaching 5,962.87 GB/sec and large block uncached reads at 217.29 GB/sec. Single-core performance, such as Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core, falls into the average tier, indicating that the instance's strength lies in parallelized, multi-threaded execution rather than single-threaded speed.

Given its massive memory capacity and high-speed local NVMe storage, this server is highly cost-efficient for resource-dense deployments that require large in-memory datasets. Benchmark results show strong database operations performance, with PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations both placing in the top 25%. It is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data-intensive ETL pipelines, and software compilation. Additionally, the presence of AMX instructions enables efficient CPU-based LLM prompt processing, making it a viable option for medium-scale AI inference tasks without dedicated GPU hardware.
